methods.name: ASNet
methods.description: A method that outperforms existing methods including the most recent ones [88, 90, 92]. It casts few-shot segmentation as the task of correlation feature transform and processes correlation features that have smaller channel dimensions.

methods.name: HSNet [45]
methods.description: Another method that casts few-shot segmentation as the task of correlation feature transform and outperforms other visual feature transform methods.

methods.name: ASNet layer with local self-attention
methods.description: Compatible with global ASNet in terms of classification exact ratio but degrades segmentation mIoU significantly.

methods.name: Attention masking in Eq. (11)
methods.description: Verifies that the attention masking prior is effective.

methods.name: Multi-layer fusion path replacement
methods.description: Replaced with spatial average pooling over the support dimensions followed by element-wise addition.

methods.name: FS-S task
methods.description: Uses Pascal-5i and COCO-20i datasets for few-shot segmentation.

methods.name: multi-label classification
methods.description: Uses ER (exact ratio) and acc (accuracy) metrics.

methods.name: segmentation
methods.description: Uses mIoU (mean Intersection over Union) metric.

methods.name: iFSL framework
methods.description: Framework used for few-shot learning tasks
